documentation_gaps.title: No explicit build instructions for openEuler kernel
documentation_gaps.body: The README.md is the standard Linux kernel README which points to Documentation/admin-guide/README.rst. While this provides generic build instructions (make defconfig, make), there are no openEuler-specific build guides or quickstart documentation for new developers.

documentation_gaps.title: Selftests dependencies not documented
documentation_gaps.body: The kselftest framework requires additional packages (libcap-devel, numactl-devel, alsa-lib-devel, libcap-ng-devel, rsync) that are not listed in Documentation/process/changes.rst. New developers may encounter compilation failures when building selftests.

problems_encountered.problem: memfd_secret selftest failed to compile: sys/capability.h not found
problems_encountered.solution: Installed libcap-devel package in the container: dnf install -y libcap-devel

problems_encountered.problem: migration selftest failed to compile: numa.h not found
problems_encountered.solution: Installed numactl-devel package in the container: dnf install -y numactl-devel

problems_encountered.problem: kcmp selftest failed: Operation not permitted (kcmp() requires CAP_SYS_PTRACE)
problems_encountered.solution: Container security restriction. Would need --privileged or --cap-add SYS_PTRACE to run. Accepted as container environment limitation.

problems_encountered.problem: CONFIG_SAMPLES not enabled in defconfig, no sample modules built initially
problems_encountered.solution: Enabled CONFIG_SAMPLE_KOBJECT=m and CONFIG_SAMPLE_KFIFO=m in .config, ran make olddefconfig, then make modules to build sample modules.
